cctvStages.title: Camera selection
cctvStages.text: We help you choose camera types for each location: dome, bullet, PTZ, solar or AI-enabled, based on what you need to see and where.

cctvStages.title: Site assessment
cctvStages.text: We look at your property, entry points, lighting, cable routes, power and internet to plan coverage before anything is installed.

cctvStages.title: Installation
cctvStages.text: Cameras, recorder, cabling and power are installed and tidied so the system looks neat and works reliably.

cctvStages.title: Configuration
cctvStages.text: Recording, motion alerts and user access are set up properly, with sensible passwords that you control.

cctvStages.title: Mobile monitoring
cctvStages.text: Where the equipment and your internet connection support it, we set up viewing on your phone so you can check in remotely.

cctvStages.title: Maintenance
cctvStages.text: Cameras get dirty, cables age and drives fill up. Maintenance keeps your system recording when you need it.

cctvStages.title: Upgrades
cctvStages.text: Add cameras, replace old equipment, increase storage or move to newer technology as your needs change.
